evidence.summary: Hybrid Greentech (Copenhagen) announced on 22 January 2026 a growth investment from Nordic Alpha Partners, which becomes a significant minority shareholder and strategic partner; existing investor PEAK Wind retains its minority share. The round is over €15M. Funds scale the AI-driven virtual power plant that aggregates batteries and distributed flexibility (EV chargers, heat pumps) and trades them across wholesale and ancillary markets for asset owners and grid operators across Europe. ABG Sundal Collier advised Hybrid Greentech on the transaction, confirming the 22 January 2026 announcement date.
